test_index_to_token_mapping: test a learner's index-to-token dictionary mapping against a provided vocabulary list
test_dictionary_type_check: test that the index-to-token answer is a valid Python dictionary type
test_enumerate_based_mapping: test a dictionary built with enumerate to map vocabulary indices to tokens
render_feedback_on_failure: render feedback with hints when the index-to-token mapping is incorrect
validate_correct_solution: validate a learner's index-to-token mapping matches the expected correct solution
